TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Data Analyst
Sample Insights LLP — Pune (Hybrid)
Salary: INR 6,00,000 - 8,00,000 per annum

Responsibilities
- Build weekly dashboards for the sales team.
- Analyse customer churn and present findings.

Requirements
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience with Python or R for analysis.
- Proficiency in Power BI or Tableau.
- Good knowledge of statistics.

Good to have
- Experience with A/B testing.
- Familiarity with Snowflake.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Machine Learning Engineer
Example AI Labs — Remote

What you'll do
- Train and deploy NLP models for document classification.
- Own model monitoring in production.

Must have
- 2+ years building machine learning systems in Python.
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Experience deploying models with Docker.

Preferred
- Experience with LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation.
- MLflow or similar MLOps tooling.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
DevOps Engineer
Placeholder Cloud Services — Chennai (On-site)

Responsibilities
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure for 40 services.

Requirements
- Experience with AWS or Azure.
- Strong Linux and shell scripting skills.
- Kubernetes in production.
- Infrastructure as code with Terraform.

Nice to have
- Prometheus and Grafana monitoring.
- Python scripting.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
SOC Analyst (L1)
Demo Secure Pvt Ltd — Noida

Responsibilities
- Monitor alerts and triage incidents.

Requirements
- Experience with a SIEM such as Splunk or QRadar.
- Understanding of network security and TCP/IP.
- Knowledge of incident response processes.
- A degree is not required.

Preferred
- Exposure to vulnerability assessment tools like Nessus.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Business Analyst
Example Fintech — Bengaluru (Hybrid)

Responsibilities
- Gather requirements from stakeholders and write user stories.

Qualifications
- 2-4 years of experience as a business analyst.
- Experience with requirements gathering and process mapping (BPMN).
- Working knowledge of SQL and Excel.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira.

Plus
- Power BI dashboards.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Inside Sales Representative (SaaS)
Sample Software Co — Mumbai
Compensation: base plus commission (not disclosed)

What you'll do
- Run discovery calls and manage a pipeline of mid-market accounts.

Requirements
- 1+ years in B2B or SaaS sales.
- Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot CRM.
- Strong negotiation skills.
- Excellent communication skills.

Bonus

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Talent Acquisition Specialist
Example Manufacturing — Ahmedabad

Responsibilities
- Manage end-to-end recruitment for plant and corporate roles.

Requirements
- 2+ years of full cycle recruitment experience.
- Experience with an applicant tracking system such as Greenhouse or Lever.
- Competency-based interviewing skills.
- Knowledge of labour law basics.

Preferred
- Experience with Workday.

TEST FIXTURE — fictional.
Financial Analyst (FP&A)
Placeholder Retail Group — Gurugram

Responsibilities
- Prepare monthly budgets, forecasts and variance analysis.

Requirements
- CA, CFA or MBA (Finance).
